Name: Adjust Baby Chance
Author: f4iThh
Description:
[i]Allows the player to adjust the question chance of wanting children.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MztFj3b.png[/img]﻿

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
This mod has [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] support.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/f4iTh/StardewValleyModding/master/AdjustBabyChance/docs/images/generic.png[/img]

Optionally, see [url=https://github.com/f4iTh/StardewValleyModding/tree/master/AdjustBabyChance#configuration]README.md[/url].

[size=4][b]Console commands[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]setbabychance[/b]: [i]Sets the chance of the baby question.[/i]
[*][b]getbabychance[/b]: [i]Shows the current chance of the baby question.[/i]
[/list]
[size=4]﻿[b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/url]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4][b]See also﻿[/b][/size][list]
[*][url=https://github.com/f4iTh/StardewValleyModding/tree/master/AdjustBabyChance]Source code[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12869]Planned Parenthood[/url]﻿
[/list]
